starters.title: 🧾 Receipt Scanner & Expense Analyzer
starters.blurb: A Squad-powered sample that reads receipt files from a folder and processes them

starters.title: A/B Test Orchestrator — Squad Edition
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that turns an experiment hypothesis into a complete A/B test plan. Provide a hypothesis at the terminal or point it at an experiment brief file, and four AI specialists collaborate to design your test.

starters.title: Appointment Scheduler
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that turns plain-text scheduling requests into optimized meeting proposals across timezones. Describe who needs to meet, when, and what to avoid — four AI specialists handle the rest.

starters.title: Bug Triage — GitHub Issues Edition
starters.blurb: A Squad-powered GitHub issue triage system — fetches real open issues from any repo using the gh CLI and triages them with a team of AI specialists.

starters.title: Compliance Checker — Codebase Compliance Scanner
starters.blurb: A Squad-powered compliance checker that scans a real project folder and evaluates compliance across security, licensing, documentation, and data privacy — with a team of four AI specialists.

starters.title: Content Creation Workflow — Squad Edition
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that takes a blog topic and produces a polished, SEO-optimized article through a four-agent content pipeline: research → outline → write → edit.

starters.title: Contract Reviewer — Squad Edition
starters.blurb: A real Squad-powered contract review tool. Point it at a contract file and a team of four AI legal specialists will extract clauses, score risk, suggest negotiation alternatives, and deliver an executive summary — all with 🔴🟡🟢 traffic-light risk flags. Sign, negotiate, or walk away — the squad tells you which.

starters.title: Email Inbox Triage — Gmail Edition
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that opens your real Gmail inbox in a browser, scrapes the visible emails using Playwright, and feeds them to a four-agent AI triage squad for actionable advice.

starters.title: Inventory Manager
starters.blurb: A Squad-powered inventory analysis demo. Reads a CSV file of product data and feeds it to a four-agent Squad that predicts stockouts, optimises reorder points, finds cost savings, and produces an actionable restock plan.

starters.title: Job Application Tracker
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that opens a real browser, scrapes job listings from any job board, and analyzes them with a team of four AI specialists — matching opportunities to your profile, researching companies, preparing application strategies, and creating a prioritized action plan so you apply smarter, not harder.

starters.title: LinkedIn Monitor & Engagement Tracker
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that opens your real LinkedIn in a browser, scrapes your notifications and messages using Playwright, and feeds them to a four-agent AI squad that tells you what needs your attention — with direct links to take action.

starters.title: Meeting Recap & Action Item Generator
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that turns meeting transcripts into structured recaps with action items, decisions, and follow-ups. Paste your notes directly or point to a transcript file — four AI specialists do the rest.

starters.title: Mood Playlist Builder
starters.blurb: Create a playlist based on how you feel, refine the songs interactively, save everything in markdown, and instantly open a YouTube playlist.

starters.title: MTG Commander Deck Builder
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that scrapes EDHREC card recommendations using Playwright, then hands them to a four-agent AI squad to build a complete 100-card Commander deck. Supports follow-up modifications in a conversation loop.

starters.title: Options Day Trader
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that opens TradingView in a real browser, reads live chart signals (VWAP, EMA 9/21, RSI, VIX), and feeds them to a four-agent analysis squad that produces trade recommendations for 0DTE debit spreads. Uses SPX as the default instrument but can be adapted to any options-tradable symbol. Paper trade only — no real orders placed.

starters.title: Price Monitor & Deal Finder
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that opens a real browser, scrapes product prices from any shopping page, and feeds them to a four-agent deal analysis squad for actionable buy/wait/skip advice.

starters.title: Real Estate Investment Analyzer
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that opens Redfin or Zillow in a browser, scrapes visible property listings using Playwright, and feeds them to a four-agent AI squad for investment analysis.

starters.title: Realtor Home Sales Package Builder
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that scrapes Redfin and Zillow using Playwright and feeds the listings to a four-agent AI squad that builds a client-ready Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) sales package for realtors.

starters.title: Social Media Content Manager
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that takes a content theme or product description and generates platform-optimized social media posts for Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram — complete with timing recommendations and engagement monitoring strategies.

starters.title: Support Ticket Router
starters.blurb: A Squad sample that reads real support ticket files from a folder and triages them with a four-agent AI squad — classifying priority, matching known issues, drafting responses, and producing a prioritized action queue.

starters.title: Travel Planner — A Squad of Travel Experts
starters.blurb: Trip planning sucks — you are bouncing between a dozen tabs, never sure you are making the right calls. This sample assembles a real team of five travel specialists (research, flights, lodging, activities, budget) that actually coordinate with each other to deliver a complete, personalized itinerary in one shot.
